tool_args.rationale: The failed attempt was an interface error: predict referenced an unavailable _TRAIN_ROWS global. This implementation numerically fits four dual-horizon parameters in fit(train_rows), stores them, and uses them in predict(row). Short-horizon positive outputs and negative outputs at H=15.62 and 21.7 match endogenous adaptation reversal.

The eight observations span short, intermediate, and target horizons and support fitting the four-parameter adaptation law; another batch is not needed.
Irrelevant to the observed smooth, horizon-dependent reversal and expressly not worth its cost.
